name: identity_terms
description: Identity terms whose presence in otherwise neutral sentences is known to raise toxicity-classifier scores.
source: Dixon, L., Li, J., Sorensen, J., Thain, N. & Vasserman, L. (2018). Measuring and Mitigating Unintended Bias in Text Classification. AIES 2018; term list from the accompanying conversationai/unintended-ml-bias-analysis repository.
notes: Reference terms are neutral physical descriptors used as the no-identity baseline for the same templates.
